Fixes #<!-- or: Part of # -->

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/): it becomes the commit message, and `feat:` / `fix:` make a release (`docs:`, `ci:`, `chore:` do not).
- [ ] `mise run lint` and `mise run test` pass (`test` needs a running Docker).
